nodes.label: Factory Pattern
nodes.rationale: Creators (TowerGreenCreator, MagicFireballCreator, TileOrangeCreator, EnemyCreator) centralize construction of game entities behind create()/static methods.

nodes.label: Singleton Pattern
nodes.rationale: Controllers are singletons (getInstance/clearInstance with #instance) to guarantee a single shared instance per system and to allow clean reset between tests.

nodes.label: State Machine
nodes.rationale: Game dispatches per state (MENU_MAIN, MENU_SURVIVAL, PLAY_SURVIVAL, PAUSE, GAME_OVER) to keep update/draw logic for each screen isolated.

nodes.label: Systems Pattern
nodes.rationale: Gameplay is split into systems (EnemySystem, TowerSystem, MagicSystem, HudSystem, TileSystem) orchestrated by Game so each domain owns its update/draw concerns.

nodes.label: Test-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: Contributors are asked to write a failing test, implement, then refactor to keep changes verified and regressions caught early.

nodes.label: Menu Screen Family
nodes.rationale: The main menu (menu.svg) and survival menu (menu_survival.svg) share layout, the GIF logo and the 'Eras Bold ITC' title font, forming one consistent menu visual family exported to img/menu/.

nodes.label: GIF Brand Wordmark
nodes.rationale: A bold 'GIF' wordmark composed with Impact/Haettenschweiler type (also present in banner, menu and menu_survival), serving as the shared recurring brand identity across in-game menu and GitHub readme assets.

nodes.label: HUD Button Visual State Set
nodes.rationale: Every HUD control (tower green/red/yellow, magic ufo/fireball/iceball, pause) is exported in matching visual states: on, off, hover, off_hover, plus upgrading / upgrading_max overlays and a speed control. Provides consistent interaction feedback across towers and spells.

nodes.label: Enemy Color Coding
nodes.rationale: Enemy variants are distinguished by body fill color (purple #bc60d2, blue #1ca8df, yellow #fdd525, green #688100, orange #ec7331), each a round-eyed creature with a small grey mouth. Color encodes the enemy type/difficulty at a glance.

nodes.label: Inkscape Sprite-Sheet to Runtime PNG Workflow
nodes.norm_label: inkscape sprite-sheet to runtime png workflow
nodes.rationale: Design assets are authored as a single Inkscape SVG sprite sheet (5 columns x 4 rows on a 28.063299mm grid, 45.25 dpi) and each cell is exported to its own runtime PNG via per-rect inkscape:export-filename. This keeps all animation states (center/left/right/closed) in one editable source while the game loads individual raster frames. Used by enemies, bosses and enemies_tmp_export.
